_doc: Power-up pack ladder (store.power_packs in stores.json holds each pack's sku and grants; the theme pack's store/products.json maps the sku to its store product id and price label). This file adds what the store does not know: the reference USD price of each tier (for the value maths only; the shown price is the theme's price_label), one-time offers, the gem-equivalent rates behind the '+X% value' labels, and what a War Banner charge does in the runner. tests/Survival.Domain.Tests/PowerPackTests.cs, docs/runner_balance.md.

value_rates._invented: Gem-equivalent value of one unit, for the '+X% value' labels and the value-per-dollar test. res.speedup_m = 1 gem is the real rush rate (base_economy.json rush.gems_per_minute); the rest are placeholders Derek has to confirm.

runner_boost._invented: One War Banner charge: every squad unit +10% damage and +10% HP for runner runs; one charge is spent per new runner level cleared while charges are left (losses and replays are free).
